what_is_false_in_the_claim: that a check mode is needed to decide an action: the five actions no check mode could guard are decided at 1.0 by attempting in a stage
that this tree's atomic publication is atomic: os.replace on a populated directory fails ENOTEMPTY, so it is atomic only for an absent target
that a refused attempt costs the world: 80 of 80 refusals left the live tree byte-identical
that one trial gives permanent knowledge of the effect: the effect is a function of the environment, and what is permanent is the licence to try
that trial-and-error is safe in general: only for effects confined to the staged tree; a network call, a process or an absolute path outside is not undoable here
that exchange is a compare-and-swap: confirmed against the Nov-2026 record, and the concurrency boundary is declared instead
